attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as DHCP router on the private network (eth1, 10.100.201.0/24) shared with node2/node3: static IP 10.100.201.1 on a new 'priv' UCI interface, added to the lan firewall zone, and a dnsmasq DHCP pool (10.100.201.100-249) plus a MAC-based static host reservation for node2 (02:80:cb:1f:a1:5e -> 10.100.201.50). Verified node2 always receives 10.100.201.50 across repeated lease renewals while node3 draws from the general pool (10.100.201.211, consistently reused). Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes sequentially (node1, then node2, then node3), confirming changed boot_id on each and full post-restart recovery: node1's UCI config/dnsmasq service persisted and resumed serving, and both node2 and node3 auto-reconnected and re-obtained their correct (reserved vs. pool) addresses, confirmed via ping from node1.
